items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I won one from Chris Kelley. That's up. Tuxedo beat me.

ctx.x: With who? I won one from Chris Kelley. That's up. Tuxedo beat me. And I won one from Rene. But me and Rene split even. I'll tell you how that come out. See my bunch gave me the cup the first time we played, and then Rene had a white bunch too you see, and they gave him the cup the next time, well he and him split even see. But I won Chris Kelley and I won one from Rene and I lose with their tuxedo. They had twelve pieces and we had six. I couldn't do nothing but lose that.
I'd really have the six myself.
